title: Twisted Block Particle Filters: A Local Particle-System Change of Measure for High-Dimensional State-Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28848v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Block particle filters mitigate weight degeneracy in high-dimensional state-space models, but their normalizer estimates can remain highly variable. We introduce a twisted block particle filter (TBPF) that incorporates predictive guidance through an exact change of measure at blockwise resampling. The method guide-tilts one uniformly selected offspring per block, leaves the state-transition kernel unchanged, and computes the resampling correction using finite empirical guide averages. We prove that this correction exactly preserves the finite-particle block particle filter normalizer expectation, separating the effect of guided sampling from the approximation introduced by spatial blocking. Our analysis provides exact conditional local moments and a one-step conditional central limit result. translated_title: 扭曲块粒子滤波器：一种用于高维状态空间模型的局部粒子系统测度变换
translated_abstract: 块粒子滤波器可以缓解高维状态空间模型中的权重退化问题，但其归一化因子估计的方差可能仍然很高。我们提出了一种扭曲块粒子滤波器（TBPF），通过在分块重采样时进行精确的测度变换来引入预测性引导。该方法对每个块中均匀选取的一个子代进行引导倾斜，保持状态转移核不变，并使用有限的经验引导均值计算重采样校正。我们证明了该校正能精确保持有限粒子块粒子滤波器归一化因子的期望，从而将引导采样的效应与空间分块引入的近似误差分离开来。我们的分析提供了精确的条件局部矩以及单步条件中心极限结果。我们进一步推导了跨块和跨时间累积校正的显式界，并建立了块滤波器的固定时域一致性……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出扭曲块粒子滤波器（TBPF），通过在分块重采样时进行精确测度变换引入预测引导，在不改变归一化因子期望的前提下显著降低高维状态空间模型中估计的方差。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Twisted Block Particle Filter (TBPF) that incorporates predictive guidance via an exact change of measure at blockwise resampling, preserving the normalizer expectation exactly while reducing variance in high-dimensional state-space models.
